description: What will be printed after adding 5 to x?
What will be printed after multiplying x by 3?
What will be printed after subtracting 7 from x?
What will be printed after dividing x by 2?
What will be printed after increasing x by 1 twice?
problem:
local x = 5
x = x + 1
x = x + 1
print(x)

description: What will be printed after swapping the values of x and y?
problem:
local x = 3
local y = 8
x, y = y, x
print(x)

description: What will be printed after adding x and y together?
problem:
local x = 6
local y = 4
local result = x + y
print(result)

description: What will be printed after taking the remainder of x divided by 3?
problem:
local x = 14
local result = x % 3
print(result)

description: What will be printed after doubling x and subtracting 2?
problem:
local x = 7
x = x * 2
x = x - 2
print(x)

description: What will be printed after increasing x by 10 and dividing it by 2?
